newsitem.title: ITALY: Consob - Olivetti stays suspended until statement.
newsitem.headline: Consob - Olivetti stays suspended until statement.

text.p: Italy's stockmarket watchdog Consob said that shares in information technology group Olivetti would remain suspended pending a Olivetti statement on its financial accounts due later on Friday morning.

On Thursday, Consob met with Renzo Francesconi, a former Olivetti director general who resigned on Wednesday after he expressed misgivings about the way Olivetti had presented its first-half 1996 results this week.

Later on Thursday, Consob met with Olivetti officials led by group chief executive Francesco Caio. After the meeting Caio said that Francesconi's statements stating his misgivings on the accounts were groundless.
Olivetti shares were suspended before trading started on Thursday and will now remain so until the Olivetti statement this morning and approval to restart trading by Consob.
